AUTHOR: Chuang
TITLE: A Feature Learning and Object Recognition Framework for Underwater Fish Images
REGION: Taiwan (Fish4Knowledge coral reef cameras); Bering Sea mid-water trawl (NOAA Cam-trawl)
SPECIES: Fish4Knowledge top-15 species (not named); NOAA set: adult/juvenile pollock, rockfish, eulachon, chum salmon, king salmon, capelin (7 classes)
DATA: Fish4Knowledge (F4K) recognition dataset top-15 species (26,418 images); self-collected NOAA Fisheries Cam-trawl dataset (2,195 grayscale images, 7 species)
V_EV: Sec. VI.A Datasets: 'discard color information due to the color distortion in deeper water' and 'illuminated by artificial LED lighting'; no stratified results
D2: 10-fold cross-validation; split unit (image vs trajectory) not stated
D_EV: Sec. VI.B: 'The 10-fold cross-validation is applied, and the final classifier is used for the testing set.'
R_EV: Sec. VI.D: 'Results of Fish4Knowledge and NOAA Fisheries dataset are shown respectively in Table II and Table III.'
C_EV: Sec. V.B: 'The optimal threshold t* found by solving (29), (30) is then used in the testing phase.' Table V: partial decision 4.92%
E_EV: Table II/III report only 'AP (%) AR (%) AC (%)'; Sec. VI.D: 'average precision (AP), average recall (AR) in addition to the accuracy (AC)'
ARCH: Unsupervised non-rigid part model (PFT saliency init, relaxation labeling, mean-shift) with dense SIFT + weighted HSV histogram features; hierarchical binary-tree RBF-SVM with benefit-based partial classification (reject option)
METR: AP, AR, accuracy, per-species precision/recall/F1, partial decision (PD) rate
NOTE: Pre-deep-learning classifier on pre-cropped single-fish images; C_ALL = NA by rule although the paper's core contribution is an optimized indecision/reject threshold (C1=Y, C4=Y) — verifier may want to flag this as a confidence-control study. Split unit: image-level 10-fold CV; F4K images come from tracked trajectories (trajectory voting applied) so frame-level leakage is plausible but not discussed. V3=Y based only on the statement that Cam-trawl images are 'illuminated by artificial LED lighting' (qualitative). NIMG = 26,418 (F4K) + 2,195 (NOAA). F4K is public but the NOAA dataset is not shared (DSHR=N). NCLASS = 15 for F4K experiments, 7 for NOAA. | C_ALL NA→P (classification study reporting a score threshold/reject rule; amended rule).
